name: fmp_forex_list
description:
Currency pairs covered by Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/forex-list as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
Use the pairs with fmp_forex_quote or fmp_forex_historical.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {}
